title: CONTINUOUS-TIME SIGNAL PROCESSING
description: Examines continuous-time (CT) signals and systems. Explores CT signals and linear time-invariant systems in time and frequency domains. Applies CT convolution in the time domain. Analyzes signals and systems in CT using CT Fourier transform, CT Fourier series, and Laplace transform.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: ECE 200 and (MTH 252Z, 252HZ, 252 or 252H).
A minimum grade of C is required in ECE 200, MTH 252Z, MTH 252HZ, MTH 252 and MTH 252H.
meeting_html: W 10am-11:50am in DEAR 222 - Dearborn Hall 222 (9/23 to 12/4)
